svg.title: Dynamo routing behind a Gateway
svg.desc: Three independent paths: Gateway to routing Frontend; Gateway and EPP to Dynamo worker sidecars; standalone EPP with stock vLLM. KV events originate from the Dynamo Runtime in the first two paths and directly from the vLLM Engine over ZMQ in the third.
svg.text: A Gateway does not require EPP. On-ramp adds Dynamo routing to stock vLLM.
Policy ownership shown; timeout, retry and fallback behavior depends on implementation and configuration.
